problemsFixed: The draft includes information from S1 (Die Zeit) in the body, but S1 is about table tennis in Frankfurt and is irrelevant to the typhoon in S2, violating the principle that every sentence must be supported by the relevant source context.
The body repeats the reporting time and source unnecessarily.
